descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
# Arcane Flight  is a radio-controlled aircraft flight simulator set in a breathtaking fantasy world!

Here you can enjoy calm, relaxing flights and smooth gliding through the clouds — or jump into intense magical arena battles against enemies.

**-Never flown an RC aircraft before?** No problem! The zero-gravity mode makes learning to fly easy and accessible.

**-Are you a professional or an RC aviation enthusiast?** Then you’ll love the variable-gravity mode — it’s challenging, fun, and truly unique.

**-Shooting and battling enemies** adds an unusual and exciting twist rarely seen in flight simulators.

The game also features a **Mixed Reality mode**, allowing you to fly in open real-world spaces.

**Although this is not a hardcore professional simulator, the vector-based physics provide a surprisingly authentic sense of flight dynamics. 
The controls are not arcade-style and require learning and practice.**

This game is made by a solo RC aviation hobbyist, for people who love model aircraft just as much.

Have a great flight!
